name: judgex
description: JudgeX is an innovative web platform designed for programming enthusiasts. It offers a wide range of features including a code compilation system, user authentication, various difficulty levels, leaderboards, and a unique online resume builder. The platform is built using pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and it leverages `localStorage` for all data persistence, making it a completely serverless application in terms of user data management. For code evaluation, it integrates with the Judge0 API.
